No other paths, extra nesting, traversal/symlink escapes, or baseline-evidence output are allowed. Python ROOT is fixed from the script location, not output depth. corpus_protocol: UTF-8 item-corpus.tsv in compact output: variant TAB item-base-key TAB escaped-name TAB escaped-description, one record per base key with both .name and .desc and no other dot in base. Escape backslash as double backslash, then LF/CR/TAB as literal backslash-n/r/t. Both descriptions and actual dictionary names are corpus-tested. Each name is drawn at all five proven Le y values, unequipped and with the exact original aDJ cut8/pad8/+ display transform; actual Le supplier itself has separate synthetic compatibility coverage. All42 selection positions are also executed separately. prepare_inputs.py defaults to frozen audit dictionary-nsfw.json(PAK) and dictionary.json(JAR). To test candidate dictionaries, run prepare_inputs.py --pak-json <decrypted-candidate-PAK-dictionary.json> --jar-json <decrypted-candidate-JAR-dictionary.json> --output-dir <output-dir>. No save data is accepted/read.
